data.title: Special use permit for moving container refused
data.summary: The City of Musterstadt (Ordnungsamt) refused your application of 2 July 2026 for a special use permit (Sondernutzungserlaubnis) to place a moving container in front of Lindenweg 12. The reason given is that the pavement is only 1.40 m wide.
data.explanation: The city has rejected your application because the pavement is too narrow to keep pedestrians safe. You may challenge this by filing a court action (Klage) at the administrative court (Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt). No prior objection step (Widerspruch) is needed. The app shows the deadline, which runs one month from notification of the decision. The action must be filed in writing or recorded at the court registry. If you don't act, the refusal becomes final. Consider getting legal advice if you want to challenge it. Otherwise, you will need another way to place the container.

items.title: File court action against the refusal

date.text: binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids

items.action: If you want to challenge the refusal, file a court action (Klage) with the administrative court (Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt) in writing or have it recorded at the court registry.
items.consequence: After the deadline the refusal becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
items.quote: Die Klage muss binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle erhoben werden.
